name: dskDitto v0.7.1
body:
Adds Bash and Zsh command-line completion and reorganizes the CLI implementation.

- Complete long flags, short aliases, hash/shell choices, and file/path arguments.
- Generate scripts with `dskDitto --completion bash` or `dskDitto --completion zsh`.
- Generate completion scripts before logging, profiling, or scanning starts.
- Keep the shared flag registry in the refactored CLI so help and completion stay aligned.

Install the CLI/TUI:

```sh
go install -ldflags="-s -w" github.com/jdefrancesco/dskDitto/cmd/dskDitto@latest
```

Install with GUI support:

```sh
go install -tags gui -ldflags="-s -w" github.com/jdefrancesco/dskDitto/cmd/dskDitto@latest
```

For Zsh, load completion after compinit:

```zsh
source <(dskDitto --completion zsh)
```

For Bash:

```bash
source <(dskDitto --completion bash)
```

Validation: all Go tests, the standard build, and its security scan passed.
